description: Wire retention_sweeper.py (built previously) into assessment_scheduler to enforce the 30-day evidence_blob expiry SLA from spec section 4 (Retention). The sweeper must SELECT rows WHERE timestamp < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' FROM mcp_signal_scores evidence_blob columns and mcp_signal_enrichments evidence_blob columns; write new rows to archive or drop per retention policy. Must use write_service :8772 for all DB operations per spec section 5. Must NOT execute DELETE on core mcp_* tables; must use UPDATE to NULL or archive pattern instead.
